data.name: Rukain
data.gender_notes: Rukain is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who restores and guards. Derived from the Arabic root 'r-k-n', meaning 'to restore' or 'to guard'. The name Rukain carries the meaning “Restorer, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rukain usually hope their child will grow to embody restorer, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Allah meaning 'The Protector'. It is also associated with the Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) who was known as the guardian of the Kaaba and was given the title 'Rukn-ud-Din' meaning 'Pillar of Faith'.
data.etymology: Rukain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Restorer, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukain total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: روكين
in_arabic.meaning: روكين يعني الثابت و القوي في العقيدة و الإيمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: روكين هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الثابت و القوي في العقيدة و الإيمان. و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم و ذكرت في سياق الحديث عن الصالحين و المؤمنين. و يعتبر اسم روكين من الأسماء التي تدل على الصبر و الثبات في وجه التحديات و المحن.

in_urdu.name: روکین
in_urdu.meaning: روکین کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور ثابت قدم ہونا
in_urdu.long_meaning: روکین ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور ثابت قدم ہونا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ورد کیا گیا ہے اور صالحین اور مومنوں کے حوالے سے بات چیت کے سیاق میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ روکین کا نام صبر اور ثابت قدمی کی علامت ہے جو چیلنجوں اور مشکلات کا سامنا کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रुकैन
in_hindi.meaning: रुकैन का अर्थ है मजबूत और आस्था में स्थिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुकैन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और आस्था में स्थिर। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और सलेह और मुमिनों के संदर्भ में चर्चा के संदर्भ में है। रुकैन नाम धैर्य और स्थिरता का प्रतीक है जो चुनौतियों और कठिनाइयों का सामना करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: روکین
in_pashto.meaning: روکین معنی یې قوي او ثابت قدم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: روکین د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې قوي او ثابت قدم دی. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې ياد شوی دی او د صالحين او مؤمنينو په اړه د خبرو اترو په منځ کې ياد شوی دی. روکین د صبر او ثابت قدمی نښه ده کومکي چې د ننګونو او ستونزو سره مخ دي.

in_english.name: Rukain
in_english.meaning: Strong and steadfast in faith and conviction
in_english.long_meaning: Rukain is an Arabic name that originates from the root 'R-K-N', which conveys the meaning of being strong, steadfast, and firm in one's faith and conviction. The name is mentioned in the Quranic context, describing the righteous and believers. It signifies patience, endurance, and stability in the face of challenges and hardships. The name Rukain holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the values of resilience and unwavering commitment to one's beliefs.

In Islamic cultures, the idea of caring for and safeguarding one's community, environment, and heritage is highly valued. Rukain can be seen as an individual who embodies these values and strives to make a positive impact on the world around them.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Rukain" holds great significance as it signifies a connection to the divine power of guardianship and restoration. In Islam, the concept of Allah (God) as the ultimate protector and restorer is central to belief. By carrying the name "Rukain," one consciously acknowledges and aligns themselves with this spiritual principle, reflecting their commitment to upholding the faith's teachings and striving for personal growth through acts of protection and restoration. This name not only serves as a reminder of one's divine mission but also as a source of inspiration and motivation to create a positive impact on both their immediate and broader communities.
